_comment: Golden LLM response fixture for the tech domain. Hand-built against the Pydantic schemas (PlanResult, TechData, EnrichmentData, SynthesisResult) — represents a valid set of per-stage LLM outputs for a Python/FastAPI tutorial video. Drift canary: if a schema or assembler change breaks parsing of this previously-valid payload, tests/test_llm_response_fixtures.py fails.

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BookCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    author: str
    year: int | None = None
snippets.explanation: Request schema — validation happens before the route body runs.
POST route delegating to the repository layer; returns 201 on success.

patterns.title: Validate at the boundary
patterns.doExample: Accept a Pydantic model in the route signature
patterns.dontExample: Accept a raw dict and validate manually inside the handler
patterns.explanation: FastAPI rejects malformed payloads before your code runs.

patterns.title: Inject dependencies
patterns.dontExample: Import a global session object at module level
patterns.explanation: Depends() makes routes testable and swappable.

cheatSheet.title: Interactive docs
cheatSheet.description: Swagger UI generated from your routes

quiz.question: What does FastAPI do when a request body fails Pydantic validation?
options: Passes the raw dict to the route
Returns a 422 error before the route runs
quiz.explanation: Validation runs at the boundary; invalid payloads never reach handler code.

quiz.question: Which command starts the hot-reloading dev server?
quiz.explanation: Uvicorn is the ASGI server; --reload watches for file changes.

quiz.question: Why use Depends() instead of a module-level global?
options: It makes dependencies visible and swappable in tests
quiz.explanation: Dependency injection keeps routes testable without patching globals.

synthesis_response.tldr: Build a working FastAPI REST API with validation, DI, and live-tested endpoints in 40 minutes.
keyTakeaways: Pydantic models in route signatures validate requests before your code runs
Depends() keeps routes testable — never import global sessions
uvicorn --reload gives a hot-reloading dev loop with auto-generated docs
synthesis_response.masterSummary: A hands-on crash course that builds a Bookshelf REST API from an empty folder: environment setup, a minimal app with a health check, Pydantic request schemas, a repository layer wired through dependency injection, and live testing of each endpoint via the generated Swagger UI.
synthesis_response.seoDescription: FastAPI crash course: build a validated, dependency-injected REST API in Python in 40 minutes.
